item.description: Since watching the 2015 film “Concussion” in my 11th-grade psychology class, I have been fascinated with chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, a degenerative brain disease common among football players caused by repeated trauma to the head and can only be definitively diagnosed postmortem. item.title: Gov. Kathy Hochul proposes new legislation to limit local and state cooperation with ICE
